question: Which cells of xylem are responsible for storage of food?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Parenchyma**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Parenchyma cells are the only living cells in the xylem and are responsible for the storage of food.
 
• They play a crucial role in the conduction of water and nutrients in the plant.
 
• Parenchyma cells assist in the repair and regeneration of tissues, particularly in the vascular tissues.
 
• These cells are also involved in the lateral transport of water and nutrients.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vessel Elements:**

 
 
• Vessel elements are elongated cells that are dead at maturity.
 
• They form continuous tubes that facilitate efficient water transportation in plants.
 
• These cells have thickened cell walls reinforced with lignin, providing structural support.
 
• Vessel elements are more prominent in angiosperms (flowering plants).
 
 
 
• **Vasculature:**
 
 
• Vasculature refers to the arrangement and distribution of vascular tissues (xylem and phloem) in plants.
 
• Xylem is responsible for water and nutrient transport from roots to other parts of the plant.
 
• Phloem transports sugars and other metabolic products downwards from the leaves.
 
• The vasculature is crucial for the overall transport system within the plant body.
 
 
 
• **Xylem Fibers:**
 
 
• Xylem fibers are elongated, lignified cells that provide mechanical support to the plant.
 
• They are dead cells with thick cell walls and are typically found in the secondary xylem.
 
• Xylem fibers contribute to the strength and rigidity of the plant stem.
 
• They are not involved in water transport but play a significant role in the structural integrity of the plant.
